description: The Leonardo identity L(n) = 2*F(n+1) - 1. F is the Fibonacci sequence with F(0) = 0 and F(1) = 1. For n = 10, L is 177 and F(11) is 89, so the difference is 0. n runs from 0 to 4096. Past 15 digits a term is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/leonardo-fib
